content:
Daloopa earnings review workflow: judge the print - what happened, versus what was expected, and how it landed.
1. On the Bench Daloopa origin, compare actuals against consensus in daloopa_consensus_estimates for the latest quarter, metric by metric.
2. Check daloopa_management_guidance verdicts for the same period - a beat against consensus can still be a guide-down.
3. Read the matching transcript from daloopa_document_search for management's own framing of the quarter.
4. Use daloopa_stock_prices quarter-end rows for the price reaction; report the move, not a narrative about it.
5. Keep expectations and results separate: never restate consensus as if it were an actual.
6. Consensus rows are not Daloopa-sourced and carry no citations; cite every Daloopa figure via source_url.
description: Review an earnings print: consensus beat/miss, guidance verdicts, filings, and price reaction.
name: Daloopa Earnings Review
